summary: Palomino Laboratories Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a binding letter of intent to acquire all outstanding shares of Vega Links, Inc., a high-speed interconnect infrastructure company. Under the proposed deal, Palomino will exchange 4,472,000 of its common shares for all Vega equity, representing an exchange ratio of 1:2.5. The agreement includes an exclusivity period through September 30, 2026, during which due diligence and definitive agreements will be negotiated. No board recommendation, advisors, or specific financial terms were disclosed. The transaction remains subject to negotiation and regulatory considerations. Watch for risk-arb angles around completion uncertainty and dilution from share issuance.
